Introduction The Springer correspondence is the canonical correspondence b etween the unipo- tent classes of a connected reductive group G and irreducible representations of the Weyl group W of G, established by Springer [Sp] in 1976. In 1981, Lusztig [L2] found a way to reformulate the Springer’s theory by means of the t heory of per- verse sheaves. In the same paper, he gave a geometric interpret ation of Koskta polynomials in terms of the intersection cohomology associated to un ipotent classes of GLn.
